messages:
matt: RFC follow-up: anti-entropy refactor for the enrichment path. TL;DR — split the current stateful enrichment monolith into a lightweight 'stager' (stateless preparation + prefix/cache keys) and an 'executor' (stateful KV cache + model clients). Want quick feedback on boundaries, fallback behavior, and rollout plan.

anya: Quick q — why not go sidecar for the stateful bits? fewer RPC hops.

matt: Sidecar considered. pros: locality, single hop. cons: per-pod memory growth for Dedicated, harder ops (sidecar lifecycle), and less flexible scaling for infrequent heavy model work. Stager/executor gives independent scaling per workload.

kevin: @matt can you drop a tiny API sketch so I can reason about error/fallback flows and payload sizes?

matt: Sure — rough sketch: 
```
POST /enrich/stage 
{ session_id, tenant_id, input } 
-> 200 { staged_id, cache_key, lite_preview }

POST /enrich/execute 
{ staged_id, cache_key, model_hint } 
-> 200 { enriched_output, cache_hit: true/false }
```
Stager returns a small payload and a cache key; executor owns heavy model calls and KV writes.

ria: Main worry: hotpath latency when execute is a remote call. Suggest AZ-affinity routing + a small local LRU for executor clients, fallback to remote executor on miss. Also consider offering a "lite" model variant for p95/99 fallbacks.

matt: Agreed — plan is: smart routing with AZ affinity, local LRU per executor process, and automatic fallback to lite-model or degraded path when overloaded. SLO targets candidates: p50 ~40ms, p95 ~150ms. Thoughts?

kevin: Do we need strong cache write semantics or is eventual consistency OK? Also how do private/on-prem installs behave?

anya: For most enrichment workloads eventual consistency + idempotency keys is fine. For regulated private installs we can expose an optional sticky sidecar mode that keeps cache local (config flag).

matt: Good. On tech-debt paydown and rollout: proposed phases — 1) behind FF: deploy stager as proxy that forwards to old monolith for now; 2) deploy executor as separate service, enable for internal tenants + canary; 3) migrate tenant cohorts and watch quality/latency; 4) deprecate monolith enrichment and remove shared state. Need owners for each phase.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment kicked off: enrichment-stager v0.1 -> canary-3 :rocket:

ria: I'll own phase 2 (executor rollout and canary instrumentation).

kevin: I'll draft routing policy, autoscale rules, and the fallback config. Aim to have draft by EOD Wed.

matt: Awesome. I'll update the RFC with the API contract and phased rollout (will link the perf targets + eval prompts). Action items: @kevin routing draft by EOD Wed, @ria executor canary plan by Fri, @matt RFC update. Closing thread unless new objections. :thumbsup:
